tree.label: Biochemistry & Molecular Biology BA — Major Requirements

children.label: Foundation Courses: General Chemistry Sequence
children.note: CH 111 does not currently resolve to a document in the `courses` Firestore collection (confirmed via a live public read, 2026-08-09), even though it's referenced elsewhere in the catalog as a valid prerequisite (CH 112's own prereq, plus EE 371/514/540) — a real, currently-offered course, just missing from the scrape/import. Sequence II can't be matched through the normal course-search add flow until that's fixed; a custom courseKey can still be entered manually via the exception form's 'course code not yet in your plan' field.

children.label: Foundation Courses: Organic Chemistry Sequence
children.note: The bulletin's '(CH 203 or CH 218) + CH 214' and '(CH 203 or CH 218) + CH 204 + CH 220' phrasing is expanded into separate fixed-course options below (SEQUENCE_GROUP options can't nest an OR within a single bundle) — CH203+CH214, CH218+CH214, CH203+CH204+CH220, and CH218+CH204+CH220 are the same two bulletin sequences written out as four options instead of two ORs.

children.label: Advanced Lab Elective
children.note: Evaluated before BMB Electives below (array order = claim priority) so a course claimed here — BB522, BI513, CH524, or the BB401+BB402 bundle — can't also be double-counted as a BMB Elective.

children.label: Advanced Lab Elective — 'any two of BB 450/451/452/453' bundle option
children.note: Besides BB 522/BI 513/CH 524 and the BB 401+BB 402 bundle (both now auto-tracked in the Advanced Lab Elective pool above), the Advanced Lab Elective can also be satisfied by any TWO of BB 450/451/452/453 taken together. Not auto-tracked — SEQUENCE_GROUP options need a fixed course list, and 'any 2 of 4' is a combinatorial choice (6 possible pairs); enumerating all 6 as separate options doesn't scale and reads as a workaround rather than a clean fit, so this stays a manual petition/verification note.

children.label: BMB Electives
children.note: CASMB722 (MB 722, corrected from an earlier GMSMB722 guess) is a catalog data gap — neither CASMB722 nor GMSMB722 resolves to a document in the `courses` Firestore collection as of 2026-08-09 (confirmed via a live public read, not just a local guess), so this elective can't be auto-tracked if a student has taken it. Same pattern as the FYW/WRI gap in HUB_REQUIREMENTS.md: flagged rather than guessed further, pending a catalog scrape/import that actually includes this course.

children.label: GMS BI 751 unit-overlap restriction
children.note: GMS BI 751 (6 units) cannot be combined with CH 373 / BB 421 / BB 422 for credit — flagged for manual verification rather than enforced automatically, since the engine has no mutual-exclusion pool-entry type.

children.label: Related: Mathematics/Computer Science
children.note: The bulletin requires 2 courses total with at least 1 from the calculus/statistics subset. Expressed as a COUNT(min 1, calc/stats-only pool) plus a REMAINDER that fills the 2nd slot from the full combined pool — composing the two guarantees the subset minimum without needing a node type that expresses 'min 1 of a subset' directly.

children.label: At least one Calculus or Statistics course
Second Related course (Calculus, Statistics, or Computer Science)
Related: Physics Sequence
children.note: PY 241 and PY 242 don't appear anywhere in the local catalog scrape (bu_courses_all.csv) or the `courses` Firestore collection (confirmed via a live public read, 2026-08-09) — unlike CH 111 in the General Chemistry Sequence above, they're also not referenced as a prerequisite anywhere else in the catalog, so this option couldn't be independently corroborated as a currently-offered BU sequence. Kept as-is since it was already in the prior bulletin transcription rather than guessed away, but worth a human check against the current bulletin.

children.label: Non-BMB petition courses (BMB Electives)
children.note: Other courses may fulfill a BMB elective by petition/department approval — discretionary, requires manual verification.

children.label: BU residency requirement
children.note: Excluding Foundation Courses, at least 5 courses counting toward the BMB major must be taken in the BU BMB Program — not tracked, since the engine doesn't currently distinguish which claimed courses are transfer credit vs. taken at BU.
